description: AutoSA resource-model search. FF, LUT, and DSP come from per-space-time HLS samples. A stored DSP of 0 means that search did not run.

skills.pattern: one resource-model training pass on space-time 0 is reused for space-time 1-5
skills.strategy: Each space-time is a different kernel id. Train inside that space-time's tmp, then search in the same tmp. The exhaustive script does this once per space_time directory. The paper fits FF, LUT, and DSP on 16 HLS samples; BRAM is estimated from buffer sizes.
required_steps: train resource models inside space_time_N/tmp before searching that space-time
keep synth sample count at 16 unless the paper setup is intentionally changed
put FF, LUT, DSP, and BRAM18K in the search resource target
guards: a model trained only on space-time 0 does not fill DSP, FF, or LUT for the other kernel ids

skills.pattern: Vitis 2023 area XML is parsed only for the tag DSP48E, so every DSP count becomes 0
skills.strategy: resource_model.py accepts both DSP48E and DSP. Vitis 2023 emits DSP. If the parser misses that tag, training records DSP 0 and the search cannot prune on DSP.
required_steps: read the DSP element as well as DSP48E
fail the training check if every sample has DSP 0 on a SIMD GEMM
guards: DSP 0 on a float SIMD PE is a parse or training failure, not a real empty PE

skills.pattern: a search log shows model DSP 0 and the run is still called the paper resource search
skills.strategy: Every earlier exhaustive row in this comparison stored model DSP 0, with a real HLS DSP beside it. That search did not apply a DSP model. HLS can still report a DSP count, including 10240 on mm1024 space-time 3, which is above the U280's 9024.
required_steps: if model DSP is 0, say the recorded search was not the paper resource search
quote HLS DSP separately from model DSP
do not treat an HLS DSP above 9024 as a legal U280 design
guards: avoid-onchip-dsp-over-u280 caps a rewritten GEMM; this skill caps the AutoSA model record
